clue.text: Short introductory play — Glasnost?

definitions.meaning: a brief piece staged before the main play of the evening
Gorbachev's openness policy lifted the Iron Curtain, the curtain between East and West, so it was a raiser of that curtain

explanation.surface: A one-act opener is staged under the title Glasnost.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the punning second sense: glasnost helped raise the Iron Curtain dividing Cold War Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: A short piece staged before the main play warms up the audience, like a theatre's opening act.

clue.text: Company doctor accepting employee's authority

indicators.note: accepting means the doctor's letters take in the employee, who sits inside them

parts.note: MD, Doctor of Medicine
a man is a worker or employee; the 's is no letter

explanation.surface: A firm's medical officer takes on a staff member's powers.
explanation.definitionFit: Command is power to give orders, the same sense as authority over others.

clue.text: Aggrieved, though relaxed about quarters

indicators.note: about means the word for relaxed goes round the compass points

parts.note: restful means relaxed, at ease
E and N, east and north, are two quarters of the compass

explanation.surface: Someone feels wronged even though calm about their lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quarters' looks like lodgings but stands for compass points; 'though' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Resentful describes someone bitter at unfair treatment, the same as feeling wronged.

clue.text: Benefit derived from a disguise, say

indicators.note: say signals that the words are spoken, sounding like another word

parts.note: a veil is a covering that hides the face, a disguise

explanation.surface: Some advantage comes from wearing a disguise.
explanation.definitionFit: Avail as a noun means use or advantage, as in 'to no avail', a profit gained.

clue.text: Informal attire for female disregarded in Paris?

definitions.meaning: a light flimsy dressing gown worn about the house
in French the feminine form of the past participle meaning neglected or disregarded

explanation.surface: A Frenchwoman ignored in Paris dresses casually.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link between the two senses; the question mark marks the French.
explanation.definitionFit: A negligee is a woman's thin loose robe, casual clothing for indoors.

clue.text: Not inclined to write a piece of poetry

parts.note: a verse is a stanza or poem

explanation.surface: Someone reluctant to compose a poem.
explanation.definitionFit: Averse means opposed or unwilling, so not disposed to do something.

clue.text: Solicitor to remove one breaking in

indicators.note: breaking in means the numeral forces its way into the word for remove

parts.note: to supplant is to oust or remove and replace
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A lawyer is dismissed for burglary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solicitor' suggests a lawyer, but here it is one who solicits, a petitioner; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A suppliant humbly begs or petitions, so is one who asks earnestly for something.

clue.text: Dispute over a name for this tree

indicators.note: in a down clue, over places the quarrel above the rest

parts.note: a row is a quarrel or dispute

explanation.surface: Neighbours quarrel about what to call a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The rowan is the mountain ash, a small tree with red berries.

clue.text: Trying experience of French exam taken externally

indicators.note: taken externally means the exam word goes round the outside of the French word

parts.note: an oral is a spoken examination
de is French for of

explanation.surface: A French oral exam proves an unpleasant test.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordeal is a painful or difficult experience, a severe trial.

clue.text: Horse's total rejection by Chinese dynasty

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, linking definition to wordplay

indicators.note: rejection means the word for total is turned back

parts.note: a sum is a total
the Tang dynasty ruled China from 618 to 907

explanation.surface: A horse's sum is turned down by an ancient Chinese ruling house.
explanation.definitionFit: A mustang is a wild or feral horse of the American plains.

clue.text: Authorise retreating soldiers to bind prisoner

indicators.note: to bind means the turned soldiers wrap around the captive
retreating means the soldiers' letters run backwards

parts.note: REME, the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British army corps
POW, prisoner of war

explanation.surface: An order is sanctioned for withdrawing troops to tie up a captive.
explanation.walkthrough: REME is a corps of British army engineers; 'soldiers' reads as plain troops.
explanation.definitionFit: To empower is to give someone official power to act, to license them.

clue.text: Reportedly a woman will shortly make this record

indicators.note: reportedly signals that the words are heard, sounding like another word

parts.note: Anna'll, the girl's name Anna plus will contracted

explanation.surface: Gossip says a woman will soon set a record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortly' shrinks 'will' to 'll; 'make this' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An annal is a yearly record of events, a chronicle entry.

clue.text: Disrespect only found in local church

indicators.note: found in means the word for only is set inside the pub

parts.note: a local is a pub, an inn
sole means only
CE, the Church of England

explanation.surface: Rudeness appears only in the neighbourhood church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'local' looks like an adjective but is British slang for one's nearby pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Insolence is rude contempt, a lack of respect.

clue.text: Frustrated when one exploit eclipses another

definitions.meaning: read whimsically as ..., one feat outdone by a greater feat

explanation.surface: Someone is thwarted when a rival's achievement outshines theirs.
explanation.definitionFit: To be beaten or thwarted is to be frustrated in one's aims.

clue.text: Wind blowing, over city with severity

indicators.note: in a down clue, over places the wind above the city

parts.note: the auster is the south wind
Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire, England

explanation.surface: A gale sweeps across a city harshly.
explanation.definitionFit: Austerely means sternly or strictly, in a harsh manner.

clue.text: Orientals in vessel each replaced by a slave

indicators.note: each says the swap happens to every such letter, so the second one changes too
replaced by means the eastern letter in the vessel gives way to the article a

parts.note: taken as written
E, east, stands for an Oriental; the plural covers both in the word

explanation.surface: Easterners in a ship are each swapped for a servant.
explanation.walkthrough: Each E (Orientals, from east) in VESSEL gives way to A.
explanation.definitionFit: A vassal was a feudal tenant bound to a lord, hence a subordinate or servant.

clue.text: Shop assistant's gall rises when abused

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, linking definition to wordplay

indicators.note: abused means the letters are mistreated and jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A sales worker gets angry when insulted.
explanation.definitionFit: A salesgirl is a young woman who serves customers in a store.

clue.text: Support claim

definitions.meaning: to keep up or provide for
to assert or insist something is true

explanation.definitionFit: To maintain is both to uphold and to declare as fact.

clue.text: Description of European refinement

definitions.meaning: the adjective for someone from Poland

explanation.surface: Elegance is how a Continental might be described.
explanation.definitionFit: Polish names a nationality and, as a lower-case noun, a shine or sophistication.

clue.text: Main road's cut into purplish-brown rock

indicators.note: cut into means the road letters slice their way inside the colour

parts.note: puce is a purplish-brown colour
the M1 is Britain's main motorway from London north, written MI; the 's is no letter

explanation.surface: A highway is carved through dark red stone.
explanation.definitionFit: Pumice is a light porous volcanic stone used for scrubbing.

clue.text: Mollusc university discovered in parts of Latin America

indicators.note: discovered in means the university letter is found within the jumble
parts of means the word Latin is broken up and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
US, the United States

explanation.surface: A shellfish species is found by academics in South American regions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parts of' reads as regions of a continent, but it signals that the word Latin is taken apart; 'America' is the country, not the continent.
explanation.definitionFit: The nautilus is a sea creature with a spiral chambered shell, a cephalopod.

clue.text: Note gull circling house, one way or another

parts.note: so (soh) is the fifth note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: circling means the gull goes round the house abbreviation

parts.note: a mew is a seagull

explanation.surface: A message notes a seagull wheeling round a home.
explanation.definitionFit: Somehow means by some means or other, in an unspecified manner.

clue.text: Where one may paint a lot of horses in oils at first

parts.note: a stud is a collection of horses kept for breeding

indicators.note: at first means taking the opening letter of each of these words

explanation.surface: An artist depicts a herd of horses in oil paint.
explanation.walkthrough: The grid as held reads STUDTO, an OCR slip for STUDIO.
explanation.definitionFit: A studio is an artist's workroom.

clue.text: Decayed, as a fairy cake might be?

definitions.text: as a fairy cake might be?
definitions.meaning: whimsically, a small iced cake nibbled by a winged insect, as fairy moths are

explanation.surface: A small cake has gone stale and nibbled.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothes chewed by insect larvae look tatty, hence the sense of decrepit.

clue.text: Tool used right away to make dryer

indicators.note: away means the right letter is taken out of the tool

parts.note: a trowel is a gardening or bricklaying tool

explanation.surface: An implement is quickly employed to make a drying device.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used' and 'to make' are links; 'right away' looks like immediately.
explanation.definitionFit: A towel is a cloth for drying oneself.

clue.text: Maybe somebody will supply this broom

indicators.note: will supply means the words provide the letters from within themselves

explanation.surface: Perhaps someone will lend a sweeping brush.
explanation.definitionFit: A besom is a brush of twigs bound to a handle, used for sweeping.

clue.text: Ring-leader caught by the two of them is in the soup

indicators.note: caught by means the leader's letter is trapped inside the pair word

parts.note: both means the pair together

indicators.note: leader means the opening letter of the word ring

explanation.surface: A gang boss is captured by a pair and lands in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the soup' looks like the idiom for trouble; 'is in the' is a link to soup.
explanation.definitionFit: Broth is a thin soup of meat or vegetable stock.

clue.text: Lower tender?

parts.note: lower read as one who lows, a bovine; tender as one who looks after something

explanation.definitionFit: A cowherd is a person who tends cattle in the field.

clue.text: A tree-trunk out East is hard to eradicate

indicators.note: out means the east letter is removed from the trunk

parts.note: a bole is a tree trunk
taken as written
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A tree trunk in the Orient is difficult to uproot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link; 'out East' reads as abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: To abolish is to do away with completely, to wipe out.

clue.text: Speak dogmatically and give up exceptional wealth

parts.note: to lay down is to surrender or relinquish

indicators.note: exceptional means the letters are out of the ordinary, rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone preaches and renounces enormous riches.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay down the law is to issue orders or opinions with overbearing certainty.
